Proposed Strategic Communication - ABM Existing Communication Studies ABM Proposed The accelerated Bachelor’s Degree/Master’s (ABM) Degree program is a five-year track designed to help you attain a combined Bachelor’s and Master’s degree.
The Master of Arts degree in Strategic Communication can be paired with any Bachelor of Arts degree from these undergraduate programs in the Harrington School: Communication Studies, Public Relations, Professional and Public Writing, Film/Media, Journalism or Sports Media Communication.
The Master’s degree requires 30 graduate credits.
Students will typically apply during their Junior year.
Upon admission to the program, up to 9 of the 400- or 500-level undergraduate credits taken toward your B.A. may double count toward the M.A. degree.
You will complete the 120 credits needed for the B.A. in your fourth year.
In your fifth year, you will take the 21 remaining graduate credits to complete the M.A.
